original_test_intent: Validate each Type 18 Device Error Address as a valid 32-bit offset within the referenced failing memory device or the defined Unknown sentinel, and verify its diagnostic lifecycle across reboot.
original_method: Collect full raw Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 evidence, retain the Type 18 device/array handles and numeric address, preserve Unknown encoding, resolve known offsets against the referenced Type 17 device size/mapping, and compare after approved reboot without injecting a fault.
manual_activity: A user supplies device-bound, sentinel and lifecycle expectations and approves reboot; no DIMM manipulation or error injection is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version and 32-bit Device Error Address/sentinel semantics
Referenced Type 17 identity, size and applicable Type 20 mapping
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection and never cause a memory error to populate this field.
Do not clear history, alter ECC policy, reconfigure addressing or touch DIMMs.
Preserve raw sentinel and bind every known offset to the referenced Type 17 handle before bounds checking.
Never treat an extended/truncated value as a valid 32-bit offset; require reboot approval and no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode sentinel or address, resolve Type 17 device identity and bounds plus Type 20/33 context, and compare complete pre/post reboot evidence.
Report dangling, out-of-range, truncated, stale or changed values without assigning the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve device-address, bounds, extended-address and diagnostic-lifecycle policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret retained diagnostic evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep -A1 cannot preserve the raw Unknown value or prove the referenced device, offset bounds and extended-address relationship.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 data; report Type 18 handle, device handle, raw/normalized offset, sentinel state, Type 17 size/bounds, mapping, freshness and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The device-relative Type 18 address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no fault generation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve the raw Type 18 device address and handle, decode the Unknown sentinel, resolve known offsets within the exact Type 17 device and mappings, apply Type 33 rules, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS platforms with Type 18 records linked to identifiable Type 17 devices.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and inventory-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 18 Device Error Address, Type 17 device and Type 20/33 mapping/address definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw sentinel preservation, failing-device identity, relative bounds and extended-address analysis.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Finds wrong-device linkage, out-of-range offsets, Unknown misdecoding and width truncation invisible to text grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative device identity/size/map and lifecycle rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field is retained diagnostic metadata; without a separately approved injection case it does not prove fault-location generation.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept Unknown/no-record or Type 33 extended information, but must state the rule per platform; a numeric value cannot pass until resolved against the referenced device.
expected_evidence: Approved device-address, sentinel, mapping, Type 33 and freshness policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 records and versions
Per-record device/array handles, raw address, sentinel state and Type 17-relative bounds result
Read-only EDAC/kernel/BMC context without injection or clearing
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Device Error Address is a valid Type 18 field distinct from the array-relative address; expected bounds and lifecycle are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding, device linkage, bounds checking and persistence comparison are software-automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw sentinel, exact device linkage, relative bounds and Type 33 awareness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its address safety/relationship coverage while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing map/spec data as readiness inputs instead of permanent blockage.

review_improvement: Prevents a device address string from passing when it is Unknown, linked to the wrong DIMM, beyond device capacity or truncated.
independent_technical_reasoning: The key distinction from array address is the Type 17-relative bound; all decoding and mapping checks remain deterministic and read-only.
